note: Unreal 5.8.2 drops FBX sockets from any file that contains a LodGroup, so recreate them after import with unreal.new_object(unreal.StaticMeshSocket, outer=mesh); the bare unreal.StaticMeshSocket() constructor is outered to /Engine/Transient and is silently lost on save. Locations are cm, rotations are Unreal rotator degrees. lod_screen_sizes must also be applied after import: an FBX LodGroup carries no thresholds, so Unreal computes its own (measured 2.0 / 0.75 / 0.5625 on a three-LOD group) and the asset sits on its lowest LOD almost always.

graph.shading_model: Default Lit (legacy) or Substrate Slab; opaque; no Cloth/Fuzz layer
graph.BaseColor: T_SmokeBomb_Detail.R x Tint  (Tint default = tint_linear; equals T_SmokeBomb_BC at the default Tint, at every mip)
graph.Detail_encoding: sRGB-encoded LINEAR detail d = albedo / Tint luminance, full range, quantised once from linear float data; import with sRGB ON (TC_Grayscale, G8): Unreal decodes before filtering and builds its mips in linear light, as it does for BC
graph.BaseColor_alt: T_SmokeBomb_BC (sRGB) directly, for a fixed-colour instance
graph.Specular_note: ORM.A is the BAKED specular mask saturate(d)^2 (d = the linear detail), box-filtered from float data before quantisation, so every mip averages the final quantity. Do NOT use a constant Specular: 0.5 greys the cloth (p50 +53 %, p10 +111 % at the reference view); the look depends on this pin
graph.Recolour: change Tint only; Specular and roughness do not follow the dye

textures.ORM: linear (sRGB OFF), TC_Masks, RGBA (A = specular mask)

textures.Detail: T_SmokeBomb_Detail (sRGB ON, TC_Grayscale, R; sRGB-encoded linear detail: BaseColor = Detail.R x Tint, equal to BC at the default Tint at every mip)
textures.ORM: T_SmokeBomb_ORM (linear, TC_Masks, RGBA: R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0, A specular mask: Specular = 0.5 x ORM.A)
textures.look_depends_on: Specular = 0.5 x ORM.A and Sheen 0. A constant Specular 0.5 greys the cloth (p50 +53 %, p10 +111 % at the reference view).
textures.memory: one material path loads BC OR Detail, not both (see the report's texture budget)
